title: Redshift 6.4 Host Galaxies of 10<SUP>8</SUP> Solar Mass Black Holes: Low Star Formation Rate and Dynamical Mass
question: What are the star formation rates, [C II] properties and dynamical masses of the host galaxies of two z=6.4 quasars with ~1e8 Msun black holes?

data.sensitivity: 0.22 mJy/beam (J0210-0456), 0.23 mJy/beam (J2329-0301) in a 2 channel (31.25 MHz) bin

what.value: Quasar Mg II redshifts and black hole masses

evidence.quote: Derived from Mg ii $\lambda2799$ observations (Willott et al. 2010b).

what.value: Comparison [CII]/FIR vs L_FIR compilation of low and high redshift galaxies

evidence.quote: for a compilation of low ($z<0.4$) and high ($1<z<5$) redshift galaxies (Graciá-Carpio et al. 2011 and in prep.)

what.value: Stacked L_FIR and L_Bol of z~6 quasars and L_FIR-L_Bol relation

evidence.quote: Figure [2](#fig:lbollfir) shows previously published data for individually-detected $z\approx 6$ quasars and stacked averages from Wang et al. (2011a) and Omont et al (2013).

external_data.citation: Wang et al. 2011a; Omont et al. 2013

recipe.method: Combine three line-free spectral windows into continuum images and measure flux density at quasar position
Convert continuum flux to L_FIR (42.5-122.5 micron) with a greybody, then SFR via Kennicutt relation
assumptions: No contribution from quasar-heated dust; Salpeter IMF; Td 33 K would give 3x lower L_FIR

recipe.method: Gaussian plus constant fit to spectrum; integrate line channels after continuum subtraction; 3 sigma upper limit for J2329 assuming unresolved FWHM=300 km/s
IMFIT deconvolved source fit; separate blue and red wing maps (5 channels each); Gaussian-fitted velocity-centroid map

recipe.goal: Compare black hole mass to dynamical mass
recipe.method: Convert FWHM to sigma and use local M_BH-sigma relation of Gultekin et al. 2009 to predict M_BH

evidence.quote:
J2329-0301 is undetected with $L_{\rm FIR} <1.9 \times
10^{11} \, {\rm L}_\odot$ ($3\,\sigma$ limit).
there is a spatial offset of $0.5\ensuremath{''}$ (3 kpc) between these peaks
magnitude $\approx 100$ km s$^{-1}$ across a size scale of $1.0\ensuremath{''}$ (6 kpc)

would be expected to have $M_{\rm BH} \approx 3 \times 10^6 \,{\rm
  M}_\odot$, a factor of 25 lower

CASA version and calibration script/flux model for Uranus

Method and aperture for the 3.4 sigma continuum flux measurement and spectral extraction
How [C II] flux integration and line luminosity conversion were done
Fit details for the Gaussian plus constant spectrum
Observed frequencies for the spectral windows
missing_for_reproduction: Spectrum extraction and flux integration details
Comparison sample unpublished data (Graciá-Carpio in prep.)
score_reason: Public Cycle 0 data and simple analysis, but imaging and extraction details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, analysis is simple, and the results are numeric (flux, FWHM, line flux), though imaging details are missing.
